description: Publish a website on OxyPages with no account and get a live HTTPS link. The link lasts 30 minutes unless the user claims it into a free account with claim_url. Up to 3 MB and 10 files. Send either html (one complete page) or files (several files, index.html at the top level). HTML, CSS, JS and images only - no SVG or PDF. After publishing, give the user url, tell them it expires in 30 minutes, and give them claim_url to keep it.

files.description: The complete file set, including index.html at the top level. Use this OR html.

encoding.description: utf8 for text (the default), base64 for images.

path.description: Site-relative path, e.g. index.html or css/style.css.

html.description: One complete HTML document, served as index.html. Use this OR files.

name: publish_page
